prompt: Create a production game background asset for Bullets of Fury Overdrive, a polished 16-bit top-down military science fiction run-and-gun/tank shooter. Resolution 1024x1536 pixels, even canvas, portrait rectangle. Strict top-down overhead orthographic view, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point. An OPEN DESERT BATTLEFIELD in warm ochre/golden sand with subtle wind ripples, pale rock shelves confined to the extreme left and right edges, a few small dark impact craters near side edges, weathered tank tread scars and shallow dusty tracks. Center 80 percent of width must remain clear, walkable/drivable sand from bottom to top. A broad northbound open sand corridor widens into an open battlefield at upper half. Keep all boulders and tall obstruction silhouettes outside center 80 percent. No vehicles, no characters, no soldiers, no tanks, no aircraft, no buildings, no UI, no text, no labels, no grid, no border, no transparency. Original rich pixel-art hand-dithered shaded terrain with crisp edges and coherent SNES/Genesis-era sprite language, larger clean terrain shapes suitable for a scrolling arena with sizable combatants. Every part of the frame is ground texture, full bleed. Strong visual distinction between low contrast traversable sand and rocky extreme sides, avoid busy noisy sand center.
